title: Parse an SSE stream incrementally
prompt: Parse an iterable of arbitrary UTF-8 byte chunks into SSE data strings. Decode incrementally; accept LF, CRLF, or CR line endings, comments, and multi-line data fields. Dispatch only on blank lines; discard an unfinished final event per SSE semantics. Provider sentinels/JSON are left as data strings.
